milestones.outcome: A macOS user explicitly selects a configured GitHub CLI account, sees its actual identity and residual-risk warning, and reads a representative fixture pull request through the shipped workbench.
exit_criteria: The account row requires opt-in, names host and observed login, and accurately warns about executable/configuration/CA/redirect/account-switch/process limitations; read opt-in does not authorize a write

A tests-disabled macOS application uses configured gh to complete viewer, provider read, bounded normalized response, and rendered representative fixture PR through real selection; a missing process or response adapter fails the public-path negative control
A changed host, login, executable or configuration fails typed without a native credential fallback; no token is extracted, logged, copied or persisted
Focused adapter, provider, composition and documentation checks pass; no live PR mutation occurs
milestones.boundary: First usable CLI read account profile; BPR-0643's 250-commit parser ceiling remains independent; publish authorization and native platform expansion remain open

milestones.outcome: The opted-in CLI profile can publish fixture review and inline comment actions through ordinary exact-target admission, an explicit per-write warning and reconciliation.
exit_criteria: Read opt-in alone never grants publication; each CLI write confirmation names host, observed account, exact PR and operation and states the remaining account-switch risk
Fixture review and inline comment traverse the real draft/Submit review entry, mutation wire transport, server reconciliation and typed terminal result
Identity/target mismatches refuse before POST; an ambiguous attempted write cannot issue another POST; token and private content remain out of logs, arguments and persistence
No live PR is written without a separately named safe target, and focused mutation/public-composition checks pass
milestones.boundary: Mac fixture publication capability; no authorization to mutate an arbitrary live pull request

milestones.outcome: Supported targets have direct connector and UI evidence, unsupported targets remain visibly unavailable, and RFC closeout records all residual risks without claiming strict containment.
exit_criteria: BPR-0787 records target-native macOS read, publication-fixture, process and warning evidence; Windows/Linux remain unavailable until their own native gates pass
The threat model, architecture, README, build/test guide and verification ledger distinguish configured-CLI trust from exact containment, preserving original failure evidence
BPR-0788 records every revised acceptance criterion against the RFC baseline with focused public-path, documentation and integration checks
RFC/index terminal status waits for RFC-BPR-0014 Auto-Verified and any required human/native evidence; no unmet criterion is marked passed
milestones.boundary: Formal RFC closeout; canonical predecessor status and missing native or safe-target evidence remain explicit
